questions.stem: The voltage and the current between A and B points shown in the circuit are ________.

image.alt: Figure for this Current Electricity question

questions.solution:
The four source branches are all connected between $A$ and $B$. Each has emf $27\ \text{V}$ and resistance $3\ \Omega$; the third branch is $14\ \text{V}+13\ \text{V}=27\ \text{V}$. All emfs are assumed to act in the same direction.
The diagonal wire $AB$ has two resistor symbols, read as $3\ \Omega+3\ \Omega=6\ \Omega$ (a single $3\ \Omega$ would give $21.6\ \text{V}$ and $7.2\ \text{A}$, matching no option).
For identical cells in parallel: $E_{eq}=E=27\ \text{V}$ and $r_{eq}=r/n=3/4=0.75\ \Omega$.
Current: $I=\dfrac{E_{eq}}{R+r_{eq}}=\dfrac{27}{6+0.75}=4\ \text{A}$
Voltage: $V_{AB}=IR=4\times 6=24\ \text{V}$
Check: each branch carries $1\ \text{A}$, so $V=27-1\times 3=24\ \text{V}$, which agrees.
Answer: (B) 24 V, 4 A
